# Mefticaret

> Mefticaret is a Turkey-based multi-tenant e-commerce platform: store builder, product and order management, payments, shipping, SEO, blog, marketplace integrations and AI tools in one panel.

Sellers open stores on their own domain; home-based sellers (Kolay Panel), B2B suppliers and the Mefticaret Messages app are also part of the platform.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mefticaret.com/en): Platform overview, features and plans.
- [How to start an online store](https://mefticaret.com/en/how-to-start-an-online-store): Step-by-step guide to launching a store.
